title: Alien and Hiker in Cosmic Field
description: A glowing purple three-eyed alien with roots for legs holds a patterned orb while standing beside a human hiker with backpack and walking stick. They are in a field of purple flowers under a black sky with a large red cracked planet, shooting stars, floating geometric symbols, and a hanging skeleton figure.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic scene featuring a tall glowing purple alien with three eyes and root-like legs holding a patterned orb, standing next to a human hiker wearing a hat, backpack and holding a walking stick, both positioned in a dense field of purple flowers against a black cosmic background with a large cracked red planet, red shooting stars, floating white geometric shapes with symbols, and a skeletal figure hanging from above, intricate line art with vibrant neon outlines
